title: The Artificial Intelligence Job Shift: Navigating the Future of Work
description: AI is changing work through automation, reskilling pressure, job redesign, management decisions, and the awkward question of who benefits.
short_description: A no-hype look at automation, reskilling, job redesign, management pressure, and what changes when AI moves into ordinary work.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A practical overview of AI in the future of work for managers, workers, founders, and readers tracking labour-market change.
